executionArgs.additionalInstruction: This is a React Native Expo WEB build served as a single-page app on localhost:5000 with client-side navigation (NO real URL routes). The app loads at / showing the Welcome screen with "Get Started" and "Login" buttons. Login credentials: email admin@subko.app, password from ADMIN_PASSWORD env. Admin login authenticates via POST /api/auth/login and lands on the home feed. The database is empty (no tasks/submissions/payments), so data-dependent tests will find nothing to act on - treat as a setup limitation, not a bug.
